notes.no_ad_group_negatives_at_launch: The launch instruction says to add only the reviewed ad-group negatives in the supplied pack. The pack is not present, so there are none to add. Independently, a SKAG carrying only Phrase and Exact 'commercial hvac installation' already requires that contiguous phrase in the query, so speculative negatives would buy little and risk blocking valid commercial intent. Barred categories are respected either way: no manufacturer name, city name, free, quote, estimate, cost, pricing, building or property manager negative is proposed.
